whatThisPluginAdds.text: Site Discovery builds a canonical public-URL registry plus XML and HTML sitemap output from published, indexable Capell content.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins can inspect which public URLs are indexable and covered by generated outputs. Search engines and other crawlers receive current sitemap routes as content changes.

developers.text: URL and discovery-output contracts let packages contribute public records while shared Actions handle deduplication, indexability, sitemap quality, and change notifications.

teams.text: Teams can see whether published pages are being offered to crawlers and correct missing or hidden URLs before discovery suffers.
